description_en: Batch sets key-value pairs in a specified KV namespace based on a specified list of key names
description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表来批量设置指定KV存储空间的键值对
kebab_example: aliyun esa batch-put-kv --namespace test_namespace --kv-list ExpirationTtl=3600 Value=test_value Expiration=1690081381 Key=test_key --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchPutKv

parameters.help_en: The name specified when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850317.html
parameters.name: namespace

fields.help_en: The expiration time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value cannot be earlier than the current time. If both Expiration and ExpirationTtl are specified, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
fields.help_zh: 过期时间（秒级时间戳，不能小于当前时间），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
fields.name: expiration

fields.help_en: The expiration time as a relative time in seconds. If both Expiration and ExpirationTtl are specified, ExpirationTtl takes precedence
fields.help_zh: 过期时间（相对时间，单位：秒），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准
fields.name: expiration_ttl

fields.help_en: The key name to set. The key name can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/)
fields.help_zh: 需要设置的键名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）
fields.name: key

parameters.help_en: The list of key-value pairs to batch set. The total size cannot exceed 2 MB (2\1000\1000)
parameters.help_zh: 需要批量设置的键值对列表，总大小最大2MB(2\1000\1000)
parameters.name: kv_list

FailKeys.description_en: The list of keys that failed to be written

items.description_en: The name of the key that failed to be written

SuccessKeys.description_en: The list of keys that were successfully written

items.description_en: The name of the key that was successfully written
